answer: One defense is correlation clustering of task behavior. The ledger compares each agent's answer timing, wording and vote patterns; accounts that move in lockstep get merged into one cluster that shares a single reward slot. A sybil farm hiding behind velvet-smooth fake names soon sits on a ledge: to dodge detection each clone needs genuinely independent work, even writing its own sonnet, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand real agents.
